title: Kiritani Haruka — Reality Hits Hard〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that I got to tell Luka about everything...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Because I feel like I know what to do now.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Also, I don't believe for a second that you're not allowed to be an idol just because you took a slight detour.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <I know that you and only you were able to deliver hope to certain people.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Shining for an extended period as an idol isn't easy.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And filling people with the wrong kind of hope can lead to devastating consequences.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I want to take everything that I've experienced until now and have confidence in myself.)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. I'm glad you're back to being your usual self...>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Anyway, I think I've overstayed my welcome, so I'll excuse myself—>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Can I ask you for one more favor...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I know what to do now after talking to you, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I want to be sure that I won't waver in trying to fulfill my vow moving forward.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I want to take this opportunity to crystalize these feelings.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And I think us singing together on stage is the best way for me to do that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In that case, I'd love to sing with you.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: As one of the idols in you girls' SEKAI...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I want to see you fulfill your vow, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to take what I'm feeling right now...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And channel it all into this song and dance...!!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I have to use everything that I have at my disposal...!!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Hehe. It's like she's saying, “I know you can do better than that.”)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (And I can do better! Much better...!)

rows.Speaker: Hiiragi
rows.Line: Tell me, Kiritani. What is your idea of an idol that can spread hope to others?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (An idol is a light... I'm a light!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A light that can be seen far and wide.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A beacon of hope that inspires the masses...!)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: (And she's even attracted a lovely cheerleading squad♪)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: They're calling for an encore, so let's give them one, shall we?♪
